scripts.dev:server: python -c "import subprocess,time; r=subprocess.run(['netstat','-ano'],capture_output=True,text=True); pids=list({l.split()[-1] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if ':5003 ' in l and 'LISTENING' in l}); [subprocess.run(['taskkill','/F','/PID',p],capture_output=True) for p in pids]; pids and time.sleep(0.5)" && nodemon backend/server.js
scripts.ml: python -c "import subprocess,sys,time; r=subprocess.run(['netstat','-ano'],capture_output=True,text=True); pids=list({l.split()[-1] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if ':8000 ' in l and 'LISTENING' in l}); [subprocess.run(['taskkill','/F','/PID',p],capture_output=True) for p in pids]; pids and time.sleep(0.8)" && python ml_service/main.py
scripts.dev:all-with-ml: concurrently -n "VITE,EXPRESS,PYTHON_ML" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev" "npm run dev:server" "npm run ml"
